packageRules.description: docker/docker-compose.yml is the file users copy. A digest there freezes every copy on one build of its tag, so it carries tags only.

The image builder's JDK must be the Gradle toolchain's major (gradle/libs.versions.toml `java`), or the build provisions a second JDK from foojay; the Dockerfile forbids that and fails instead. Raise this bound together with the toolchain.
